recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR-core change is needed for FHIR-28213 unless Patient Care later decides to broaden Goal.addresses beyond the current explicit target list or remove intervention resources.
issue_request: FHIR-28213 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Goal change request from Patient Care asking that Goal.addresses support referencing Procedure. The issue discussed whether Reference(Any) should be allowed, but the final resolution was narrower: Goal.addresses should support referencing Procedure.
initial_application: Commit 6efe98814b6d5deb36428a713323aa26e15e4333 applied J#28213 by adding the Procedure targetProfile to source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml and adding J#28213 to the Goal.addresses committee note.
additional_context: Goal is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Later same-element work did not reverse the Procedure addition: FHIR-37261 added NutritionIntake, and FHIR-40777 considered removing Procedure and other intervention/request resources but resolved to keep the target list and clarify the definition to resources that provide context for why the goal exists. FHIR-38037 is a duplicate/background CarePlan.addresses Procedure issue, not an independent Goal source decision here. Zulip searches found no direct conflicting discussion, and Confluence references aligned with the Patient Care decision trail.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/goal/structuredefinition-Goal.xml Goal.addresses element includes targetProfile Procedure, records J#28213 in committee notes, and uses the later FHIR-40777 definition that narrows the meaning without removing Procedure.
